rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night and day are two signs that their Creator is one, unlike anything, and that indicate the years and calculation.
rows.anchor: أي علامتين يدلان على أن خالقهما واحد ليس كمثله شيء وتدلان على عدد السنين والحساب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night sign points to night through its darkness.
rows.anchor: جعلنا آية الليل دليلة عليه بظلمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Daylight was made illuminating so people can see how to conduct their affairs.
rows.anchor: جعلناها تضيء لكم لتبصروا كيف تصرفون في أعمالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says the moon once shared the sun's light, and God erased its radiance with the darkness placed in it.
rows.anchor: ويروى أن القمر كان في ضياء الشمس فمحا الله ضياءه بالسواد الذي جعل فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author prefers accusative كل, with an implicit فصلنا governing it; the verse means God detailed everything distinctly. Raising كل is also allowed.
rows.anchor: والاختيار النصب في. " كل ". المعنى في النصب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both accusative and nominative are grammatically possible for كل in this clause, though the author knows no reader who used the nominative.
rows.anchor: وكذلك النصب والرفع في قوله: (وكل إنسان ألزمناه طائره في عنقه) إلا إني لا أعلم أحدا قرأ بالرفع

rows.speaker: التفسير
rows.claim: The gloss for a person's طائر is their good and evil.
rows.anchor: وجاء في التفسير: طائره، أي خيره وشره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author explains طائر as what a person brings upon himself through his deeds; it remains attached like a necklace, as in the saying that one's sin is on another's neck.
rows.anchor: وهو - والله أعلم - ما يتطير من مثله من شيء عمله كما قال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording has four reported forms: ونخرج له, ويخرج له with God as subject, and ويخرج له with the person's deeds as the subject or referent.
rows.anchor: وفي هذه أربعة أوجه: وتخرج له، ويخرج له، أي ويخرج الله له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كتابا is accusative as a circumstantial qualifier describing what he meets spread open.
rows.anchor: (كتابا يلقاه منشورا) منصوب على الحال.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بنفسك is nominative in syntactic position despite the prefixed ب; the sense is that one's own self suffices as a witness against oneself.
rows.anchor: (بنفسك) في موضع رفع، وإن كان مجرورا بالباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outside the Quran, حسيبة could be used; the meaning is that the self has sufficed as its own reckoner.
rows.anchor: جاز. . كفى بنفسك اليوم حسيبة، والمعنى كفت نفسك حسيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حسيبا is accusative as a specification (تمييز).
rows.anchor: (حسيبا) منصوب على التمييز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: وزر is used in forms including وزر يزر and وزرا/وزرة, and means to sin.
rows.anchor: يقال: وزر يزر فهو وازر وزرا، ووزرا، وزرة، ومعناه أثم يأثم إثما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation is that no sinner or wrongdoer is punished for another person's sin.
rows.anchor: أحدهما أن الآثم والمذنب، لا يؤخذ بذنبه غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second interpretation forbids committing a sin on the excuse that one's predecessors did so, as the disbelievers claimed about their ancestors.
rows.anchor: والوجه الثاني أنه لا ينبغي للإنسان أن يعمل بالإثم لأن غيره عمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not punish until He clarifies what incurs punishment and what leads to entry into Paradise.
rows.anchor: أي حتى نبين ما به نعذب، وما من أجله ندخل الجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The light reading أمرنا is explained on the pattern of فعلنا; آمرنا is on the pattern of أفعلنا; a reading doubles the م.
rows.anchor: تقرأ أمرنا مخففة على تقدير فعلنا (1)، وتقرأ آمرنا مترفيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the light reading, أمرنا means God commanded the elite to obey, but they disobeyed; فسقوا denotes opposition to God's command.
rows.anchor: المعنى أمرناهم بالطاعة ففسقوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author argues that as disobedience is opposition to an order, فسقوا likewise means they opposed God's command.
rows.anchor: فقد علم أن المعصية مخالفة الأمر، وكذلك الفسق مخالفة أمر الله

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: A prophetic saying uses مأبورة and مأمورة of a fruitful palm and abundant mare, supporting the meaning of increase.
rows.anchor: قول النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - " خير المال سكة مأبورة ومهرة مأمورة "

rows.speaker: الشاعر
rows.claim: The cited verse uses أمروا for becoming numerous; it serves as Arabic evidence for the alternative meaning of abundance.
rows.anchor: إن يغبطو يهبطوا وإن أمروا. . . يوما يصيروا للهلك والنفد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some interpret أمرنا as increasing the elite; آمرنا also means increasing them, either in number or in wealth and prosperity.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ آمرنا فتأويله أكثرنا، والكثرة ههنا يصلح أن يكون شيئين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The doubled reading أمرنا means that God gave the elite command and authority.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ أمرنا بالتشديد، فمعناه سلطنا مترفيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كم denotes many generations destroyed through different punishments, including Lot's people, ʿAd, Thamud, and many others; كم is the object of أهلكنا.
rows.anchor: أي أهلكنا عددا كبيرا من القرون، بأنواع العذاب، نحو قوم لوط وعاد وثمود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: العاجلة means this world; God hastens to a person who seeks it only what God wills, for whomever God wills, not whatever the person wills.
rows.anchor: أي من كان يريد العاجلة بعمله، أي الدنيا، عجل الله لمن أراد أن يعجل له مايشاء الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the implied subject of نشاء is the servant: God gives the servant what he desires, if God wills it.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون المضمر في نشاء " من "، المعنى عجلنا للعبد ما يشتهيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threat of Hell follows because the person did not intend God through his deed.
rows.anchor: ثم جعلنا له جهنم). لأنه لم يرد الله بعمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مذموما and مذءوما have the same meaning.
rows.anchor: ومذءوما في معنى واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مدحورا means driven far away from God's mercy; دحر means to drive someone away.
rows.anchor: أي مباعدا من رحمة الله. يقال: دحرته أدحره دحرا ودحورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God grants provision from His bounty to both believers and disbelievers.
rows.anchor: أي نمد المؤمنين والكافرين من عطاء ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قضى means commanded.
rows.anchor: معناه أمر ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about parents means God commanded people to treat their parents well.
rows.anchor: أي أمر أن يحسنوا بالوالدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In يبلغان, أحدهما is the subject and كلاهما is coordinated with it; alternatively both are apposition to the dual alif in يبلغان.
rows.anchor: ترفع (أحدهما) ب (يبلغن)، و (كلاهما) عطف عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has يبلغان; on this reading أحدهما or كلاهما is apposition to the dual alif.
rows.anchor: ويقرأ: (يبلغان عندك الكبر)، ويكون أحدهما أو كلاهما بدل من الألف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Af has seven dialectal forms: kasra or damma without or with tanwin, fatha without or with tanwin, and an extra form أفي with ي, which is not a permissible Quran reading.
rows.anchor: في قوله (أف) سبع لغات: الكسر بغير تنوين، والكسر بتنوين، والضم بغير تنوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Af is an indeclinable sound-expression; without tanwin it is definite, while tanwin makes it indefinite like other sound words.
rows.anchor: وأف غير متمكن بمنزلة الأصوات، فإذا لم تنون فهي معرفة، وإذا نون فهو نكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kasra and fatha address the meeting of two silent letters; fatha with gemination is apt because the vowel is light and doubling heavy, and damma suits the preceding damma.
rows.anchor: فأما الكسر فلالتقاء الساكنين، وأف غير متمكن بمنزلة الأصوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Af was glossed as stench, or as dirt under fingernails; taf means something trivial such as ear dirt or a splinter taken from the ground.
rows.anchor: ومعنى أف النتن، وقيل إن أف وسخ الأظفار، والتف الشيء الحقير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command forbids speech that conveys impatience or harm; when parents are old, one should serve them as they once cared for and served the child.
rows.anchor: لا تقل لهما ما فيه أذى بتبرم، أي إذا كبرا، أو أسنا فينبغي أن تتولى من خدمتهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not rebuke them by speaking irritably or shouting in their faces.
rows.anchor: ولا تنهرهما بمعنى: لا تنتهرهما، أي لا تكلمهما ضجرا صائحا في أوجههما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نهرته and انتهرته have the same meaning.
rows.anchor: يقال نهرته أنهره نهرا، وانتهرته أنتهره انتهارا، بمعنى واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has ذل with kasra on ذ; the command means soften one's side toward one's parents in humble, abundant compassion.
rows.anchor: وتقرأ الذل - بكسر الذال - ومعنى (اخفضن لهما جناح الذل)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The root ذل is used for a humble man and a docile animal; both forms may be used of a human.
rows.anchor: رجل ذليل بين الذل، وقد ذل يذل ذلا، ودابة ذلول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الأواب is the repentant person who repeatedly returns to God in every command and desists from all prohibitions; آب means to return.
rows.anchor: الأواب بمعنى التواب، والراجع إلى الله في كل ما أمر به، المقلع عن جميع ما نهى عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: تبذير means wasteful spending.
rows.anchor: معناه لا تسرف

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One reported definition of wasteful spending is spending on things outside obedience to God.
rows.anchor: وقيل: التبذير النفقة في غير طاعة الله

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another report says pre-Islamic Arabs slaughtered camels and squandered wealth for pride and reputation; God ordered spending in ways that draw one near to Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل كانت الجاهلية تنحر الإبل وتبذر الأموال، تطلب بذلك الفخر والسمعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The squanderers are brothers of devils because they do what Satan entices them to do.
rows.anchor: أي يفعلون ما يسول لهم الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronouns in عنهم refer to the relatives, the needy person, and the wayfarer mentioned in the preceding verse.
rows.anchor: هذه الهاء والميم يرجعان على ذي القربى والمسكين وابن السبيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning away while seeking mercy means seeking hoped-for provision from God.
rows.anchor: أي وإن أعرضت عنهم، ابتغاء رحمة من ربك ترجوها، أي لطلب رزق من ربك ترجوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ابتغاء is accusative as a purpose object: turning away from them is for seeking mercy from God.
rows.anchor: (ابتغاء) منصوب لأنه مفعول له، المعنى: وإن اعرضت عنهم لابتغاء رحمة من ربك

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: A report says that when asked for help without anything to give, the Prophet would wait for provision; after the verse he would say God would provide from His bounty for both parties.
rows.anchor: وروي أن النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - كان إذا سئل وليس عنده ما يعطى أمسك انتظار الرزق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ميسورا means easing their poverty through a prayer for them.
rows.anchor: فتأويل قوله: (ميسورا) والله أعلم أنه يكسر عليهم فقرهم بدعائه لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ساء سبيلا means that fornication is an evil way, and سبيلا is accusative as a specification (تمييز).
rows.anchor: أي وساء الزنا سبيلا. و (سبيلا) منصوب على التمييز

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says the believer's killing is forbidden except after apostasy, intentional murder of a believer, or adultery after being previously married.
rows.anchor: كذلك قال قتادة في تفسير هذه الآية.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person killed مظلوما is one who was killed without committing any of those three offenses.
rows.anchor: أي من غير أن يأتي بواحدة من هذه الثلاث.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Assimilating dāl into jīm is better; clear pronunciation is also eloquent, since the letters are articulated at different but neighboring places.
rows.anchor: الأجود إدغام الدال في الجيم، والإظهار جيد بالغ، لأن الجيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A victim's ولي is a relative entitled to demand blood compensation; if there is no relative, the ruler is the guardian.
rows.anchor: ووليه الذي بينه وبينه قرابة توجب المطالبة بدمه. .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سلطانا means a proof or warrant.
rows.anchor: و" سلطانا " أي حجة.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb is read in the jussive as a prohibition; it is also read with either ي or ت, and another reading has the indicative.
rows.anchor: القراءة الجزم على النهي، ويقرأ بالياء والتاء جميعا، وتقرأ فلا يسرف بالرفع

rows.speaker: أكثر الناس
rows.claim: Most commentators define excess in killing as the victim's guardian killing someone other than the actual killer.
rows.anchor: فقال أكثر الناس: الإسراف أن يقتل الولي غير قاتل صاحبه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view defines excess as the guardian, rather than the ruler, personally killing the offender; Arabs could demand several lives for one slain leader of higher status.
rows.anchor: وقيل: الإسراف أن يقتل هو القاتل دون السلطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unjustly slain victim is supported in this life by the killer's execution and in the next by abundant reward, while the killer remains in Hell.
rows.anchor: فأما نصرته في الدنيا فقتل قاتله، وأما في الآخرة فإجزال الثواب له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With the indicative reading, the guardian is not excessive if he executes the killer and refuses blood money.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ فلا يسرف - في القتل - بالرفع - فالمعنى أن وليه ليس بمسرف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A caretaker may use an orphan's wealth only to meet hunger and cover nakedness, and should manage it constructively until the orphan reaches maturity.
rows.anchor: ولا تأكلوا - إذا أقمتم عليه إلا ما يسكن الجوعة، ولا تكتسوا إلا ما ستر العورة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view says reaching maturity means reaching marriageable age; another sets it at eighteen years.
rows.anchor: وأشده أن يبلغ النكاح، وقيل: أشده أن يأتي له ثماني عشرة سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Maturity is puberty together with sound judgment: no mental impairment and prudence in managing wealth.
rows.anchor: وبلوغ أشده هو الاحتلام، وأن يكون مع ذلك غير ذي عاهة في عقل وأن يكون حازما في ماله

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Some say they do not know what عهد means; the author explains it broadly as every covenant with God and every agreement between people.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم: لا أدري ما العهد، والعهد كل ما عوهد الله عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author connects the instruction to fulfill covenants with the parallel command to fulfill God's covenant when making one.
rows.anchor: وكذلك قوله:، (وأوفوا بعهد الله إذا عاهدتم)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قسطاس is read with either damma or kasra on ق; it is glossed as a steelyard or a weighing scale, and generally means a just balance for any measure of goods.
rows.anchor: والقسطاس جميعا - بالضم - والكسر - قيل: القسطاس هو القرسطون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Keeping full measure is better than shortchanging; more broadly, it brings about the best outcome for the person who fulfills his duty.
rows.anchor: معنى (وأحسن تأويلا) أن الوفاء أحسن من النقصان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One must not make claims about anything without knowledge; if even the Prophet was forbidden, the rest of his community and those who wrong themselves have greater reason to obey.
rows.anchor: أي لا تقولن في شيء بما لا تعلم. فإذا نهي النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: قفا means to follow a trace; the warning is not to let one's tongue or reasoning follow claims without knowledge.
rows.anchor: يقال قفوت الشيء أقفوه قفوا إذا اتبعت أثره، فالتأويل لا تتبعن لسانك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing, sight, and the heart are witnesses against a person, as bodily members testify to deeds.
rows.anchor: (إن السمع والبصر والفؤاد) شواهد عليك.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has a still ف and derives the verb from قاف يقوف, treated as a reversed form of قفا يقفو with the same meaning.
rows.anchor: ويقرأ. . (ولا تقف ما ليس لك به علم) بإسكان الفاء وضم القاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كل takes a singular predicate because the word is singular; أولئك can refer to a group of people, other beings, or inanimate things.
rows.anchor: وقال: (كان)، لأن " كل " في لفظ الواحد؛ فقال (أولئك) لغير الناس

rows.speaker: جرير
rows.claim: Jarir's verse uses أولئك to point to أيام, illustrating that the demonstrative can refer to inanimate things.
rows.anchor: قال جرير: ذم المنازل بعد منزلة اللوى. . . والعيش بعد أولئك الأيام

rows.speaker: الأخفش
rows.claim: Al-Akhfash says the reading مرحا is better than مرحا.
rows.anchor: وزعم الأخفش أن مرحا أجود من مرحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author rejects that preference: both the verbal noun and active participle are good, but the verbal noun is more emphatic; the fatha reading is more common.
rows.anchor: وهذا - أعني المصدر - جيد بالغ، وكلاهما في الجودة سواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مرحا means walking arrogantly and boastfully.
rows.anchor: وتأويل الآية: ولا تمش في الأرض مختالا ولا فخورا

rows.speaker: قالوا
rows.claim: تخرق الأرض is explained as cutting across the earth, or alternatively piercing it; the author's point is that human power cannot do this or reach the mountains, so arrogance has no basis.
rows.anchor: قالوا: معنى (تخرق الأرض) تقطع الأرض، وقيل تثقب الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سيئه means its wrongdoing; the author prefers the uninflected masculine form because the passage also contains good acts, not only prohibitions.
rows.anchor: سيئه في معنى خطيئة، وكان أبو عمرو لا يقرأ (سيئه)، ويقرأ (سيئة)

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو
rows.claim: Abu Amr does not read سيئه and instead reads سيئة; the author calls this wrong because the passage includes good instructions too.
rows.anchor: وكان أبو عمرو لا يقرأ (سيئه)، ويقرأ (سيئة)، وهذا غلط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the feminine reading سيئة, كل encompasses only what God prohibited, so all such acts are evil.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ سيئة جعل " كلا " إحاطة بالمنهى عنه فقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مدحورا means driven away from God's mercy.
rows.anchor: أي مباعدا من رحمة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arab pagans claimed angels were God's daughters; the rebuke asks whether God selected sons for them while taking the inferior share from angels.
rows.anchor: كانت الكفرة من العرب تزعم أن الملائكة بنات الله، فوبخوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: صرفنا means We explained or made clear.
rows.anchor: وقوله: (ولقد صرفنا في هذا القرآن ليذكروا وما يزيدهم إلا نفورا (41) أي بينا.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clarification only increases the deniers' aversion, as the Quran says it brings believers healing but wrongdoers greater loss.
rows.anchor: أي ما يزيدهم التبيين إلا نفورا، كما قال الله - عز وجل -:

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading with تقولون addresses the people making the claim directly.
rows.anchor: فمن قرأ (كما تقولون) فعلى مخاطبة القائلين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preferred explanation, accepted by exegetes, is that alleged rival gods would seek a way to draw near to the Lord of the Throne.
rows.anchor: أي لتقربوا إلى ذي العرش، كما قال

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Another explanation is that the alleged gods would oppose God and seek exclusive possession of divinity.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم: (إذا لابتغوا إلى ذي العرش سبيلا) أي لكانوا مضادين له

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One view says every created thing glorifies God, even the creaking of a roof or door; on this reading the address about not understanding is directed only to polytheists.
rows.anchor: قيل إن كل ما خلق الله يسبح بحمده وإن صرير السقف وصرير الباب من التسبيح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another possibility is that the glorification of these things is knowledge God has taught, and people understand only what He teaches them.
rows.anchor: وجائز أن يكون تسبيح هذه الأشياء مما علم الله به، لايفقه منه إلا ما علمنا

rows.speaker: قوم
rows.claim: Some say every thing signifies that God created it and that its wise Creator is free of defects; disbelievers fail to grasp this evidence in creation.
rows.anchor: وقال قوم: (وإن من شيء إلا يسبح بحمده) أي ما من شيء إلا وفيه دليل أن الله خالقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author rejects that explanation: the people addressed already acknowledged God as their Creator, so they could not be unaware of the act of creation itself.
rows.anchor: وهذا ليس بشيء لأن الذين خوطبوا بهذا كانوا مقرين بأن الله خالقهم

rows.speaker: أهل اللغة
rows.claim: The language scholars gloss مستورا here as ساتر, a concealing barrier, and the author suggests the seal placed over their hearts.
rows.anchor: قال أهل اللغة معنى (مستورا) ههنا في موضع ساتر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أكنة is the plural of كنان, something that covers or conceals.
rows.anchor: والأكنة جمع كنان وهو ما ستر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أن يفقهوه can mean because they dislike understanding it or so they do not understand it; the meanings are close, but the first is better Arabic.
rows.anchor: وقيل معناه ألا يفقهوه والمعنيان واحد، غير أن كراهة أجود في العربية

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the barrier as God's preventing them from reaching the Prophet; مستورا may also mean hidden from their sight and knowledge, referring to the heart's unseen seal.
rows.anchor: وقيل: (جعلنا بينك وبين الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة حجابا مستورا) الحجاب منع الله إياهم من النبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: وقر means heaviness in hearing; وَقْر is what a person carries as a load.
rows.anchor: الوقر ثقل السمع، والوقر أن يحمل الإنسان وقره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نفورا may be an infinitive meaning they turned away in aversion, or a plural of نافر like شاهد/شهود.
rows.anchor: أحدهما المصدر. المعنى: ولوا نافرين نفورا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نجوى is a verbal noun; وإذ هم نجوى means they were people engaged in private conversation.
rows.anchor: (نجوى) في معنى المصدر، أي وإذ هم ذوو نجوى، والنجوى اسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They listened to the Prophet and privately called him a magician, bewitched, and similar things.
rows.anchor: وكانوا يستمعون من النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - ويقولون بينهم: هو ساحر وهو مسحور

rows.speaker: أهل اللغة
rows.claim: One linguistic explanation takes مسحورا as having human viscera, supporting the claim that he is an ordinary mortal who eats food.
rows.anchor: أحدهما أن مسحورا ذو سحر، والسحر الرنة، وقالوا: إن تتبعون إلا من له سحر

rows.speaker: لبيد
rows.claim: Labid's cited poem uses المسحر to witness the lexical interpretation of مسحورا.
rows.anchor: قال لبيد: فإن تسألينا فيم نحن فإننا. . . عصافير من هذا الأنام المسحر

rows.speaker: أهل اللغة
rows.claim: A second linguistic explanation takes مسحورا as enchanted and removed from sound judgment.
rows.anchor: وقالوا: مسحورا أي قد سحر وأزيل عن حد الاستواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رفات means dust or anything crushed and broken; words of this kind follow the pattern فعال, such as فتات, حطام, رفات, and تراب.
rows.anchor: الرفات التراب، والرفات أيضا كل شيء حطم وكسر، وكل ما كان من هذا النحو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: جديدا means renewed.
rows.anchor: خلقا جديدا)، في معنى مجدد

rows.speaker: أكثر ما جاء في التفسير
rows.claim: Most transmitted explanations identify the form that seems immense in people's hearts as death; another view identifies it as the heavens, earth, or mountains.
rows.anchor: أكثر ما جاء في التفسير في قوله: (أو خلقا مما يكبر في صدوركم) إن هذا الخلق هو الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The objection is that people cannot make themselves stones or iron; the answer is that they already acknowledge God's power to create them, and the same power can resurrect them even if they were stones, iron, or death.
rows.anchor: فالجواب في ذلك أنهم كانوا يقرون أن الله جل ثناؤه خالقهم، وينكرون أن الله يعيدهم خلقا آخر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: فسيُنغضون means they will move their heads in a gesture that dismisses the claim and shows impatience.
rows.anchor: أي فسيحركون رؤوسهم تحريك من يبطل الشيء ويستبطئه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أنغضت رأسي means I moved my head; نغضت السن describes a tooth moving, and نغض برأسه means he moved his head.
rows.anchor: يقال أنغضت رأسي إذا حركته أنغضه إنغاضا، ونغضت السن تنغض نغضا

rows.speaker: العجاج
rows.claim: Al-Ajjaaj's line uses نغضا as evidence for the root's sense of movement.
rows.anchor: قال العجاج. أسك نغضا لا يني مستهدجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The day when God calls is the day of resurrection, when He restores people.
rows.anchor: أي يعيدكم يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Responding with praise means responding while acknowledging that God is their Creator.
rows.anchor: ومعنى تستجيبون بحمده. تستجيبون مقرين بأنه خالقكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning David and the Psalms shows that God favored some prophets over others, so people should not deny Muhammad's special favor of the Quran.
rows.anchor: أي فلا ينكروا تفضيل محمد - صلى الله عليه وسلم - وإعطاءه القرآن، فقد أعطى الله داود الزبور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command is to call those whom people claimed were their gods; none can remove harm or transfer it elsewhere.
rows.anchor: أي ادعوا الذين زعمتم أنهم آلهتكم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: One explanation identifies the invoked beings as Ezra and Jesus, whom Jews and Christians claimed as gods.
rows.anchor: منها أنه قيل: قل ادعوا العزير وعيسى لأن النصارى واليهود زعموا أن هؤلاء آلهتهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation identifies them as angels, some of whom people worshipped.
rows.anchor: وقيل إنه يعنى به الملائكة لأن منهم من كان يعبد الملائكة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A third explanation concerns Arabs who worshipped jinn; those jinn later became Muslims without their worshippers knowing, and cannot benefit or harm them.
rows.anchor: وقيل إن قوما من العرب كانوا يعبدون نفرا من الجن، فأسلم أولئك النفر من الجن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verb يَدْعون is read with either ي or ت.
rows.anchor: بالياء والتاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أولئك is the subject, الذين is its nominative modifier, and يبتغون is the predicate; الوسيلة, السؤال, السؤل, and الطلبة share a meaning.
rows.anchor: (أولئك) رفع بالابتداء، و (الذين) رفع صفة لهم، و (يبتغون) خبر الابتداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On one parsing, أيهم أقرب is a question with أيهم as subject and أقرب as predicate: the worshippers seek which being is nearest so they may use that being as a means.
rows.anchor: إن شئت " أيهم " كان رفعا بالابتداء، والخبر (أقرب)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The distinction is that believers seek God through love of prophets, angels, and righteous servants while worshipping God alone; disbelievers worship others as a means and thereby make their means an act of unbelief.
rows.anchor: فالفرق بين المتوسلين إلى الله بمحبة أنبيائه وملائكته وصالحي عباده أنهم يتوسلون بهم موحدين الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another parsing makes أيهم أقرب appositional to the plural subject of يبتغون: each seeks the nearest means to God through righteous action.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون (أيهم أقرب) بدلا من الواو في (يبتغون)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those treated as gods are themselves hoping for God's mercy and fearing His punishment.
rows.anchor: أي الذين يزعمون أنهم آلهة يرجون ويخافون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every town's people will be destroyed before the Resurrection, either through death or an overwhelming punishment; this outcome is written.
rows.anchor: أي ما من أهل قرية ألا سيهلكون، إما بموت وإما بعذاب يستأصلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مسطورا means written.
rows.anchor: كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا). أي مكتوبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first أن is accusative and the second nominative; denial by earlier peoples is the sole reason signs were withheld, since they demanded signs whose denial had brought earlier nations punishment.
rows.anchor: (أن) الأولى نصب، و (أن) الثانية رفع. المعنى ما منعنا الإرسال ألا تكذيب الأولين.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appointed time for this community's disbelievers is the Hour, delayed until then as mercy and favor.
rows.anchor: فأعلم الله - جل ثناؤه - أن موعد كفار هذه الأمة الساعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The she-camel sign is read مبصرة in one reading, meaning it made the people see or clarified the truth; another reading means manifest, and ظلموا بها means they denied it.
rows.anchor: ويقرأ (مبصرة) فمن قرأ (مبصرة)، فالمعنى تبصرهم، أي تبين لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أحاط بالناس means all people are in God's grasp; Hasan instead says God protected Muhammad from their killing or overpowering him, as in the verse about God's protection from people.
rows.anchor: وعن الحسن أحاط بالناس أي حال بينهم وبين أن يقتلوك أو يغلبوك

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The vision was the night journey to Jerusalem; some people apostatized when told of it, while sincere believers grew stronger in faith.
rows.anchor: جاء في التفسير أنها رؤيا بيت المقدس حين أسري به، وذلك أنه ارتد بعضهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another report says he saw people ascending pulpits in a dream, which distressed him, and was told it was a worldly gift.
rows.anchor: وجاء في التفسير أنه يرو رأى في منامه قوما يرقون المنابر فساءه ذلك

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The cursed tree is the tree of zaqqum, whose fruit is food for sinners and fills their bellies.
rows.anchor: قيل في التفسير الملعون أكلها، وهي شجرة الزقوم التي ذكرها الله في القرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Jahl mocked zaqqum as merely dates with butter, then ate it; others objected that fire cannot grow trees, and these claims became a trial.
rows.anchor: فافتتن بها المشركون، فقال أبو جهل: ما نعرف الزقوم إلا أكل التمر بالزبد فتزقموا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree is called cursed because its disbelieving eaters are cursed; Arabs also call harmful, disliked food accursed.
rows.anchor: فالجواب في ذلك لعن الكفار وهم آكلوها. وجواب آخر أيضا أن العرب تقول لكل طعام مكروه وضار: ملعون
